email.subject: Re: Reference for Riverside Food Bank
email.body:
Hi Jo,

Of course, I'd be glad to be your reference. Put me down as Elena Varga; the best way to reach me is my cell, 555-0139, or this email.

Also, the coordinator there told me orientation for new volunteers is Sunday, October 18, 2026, so that's the earliest you could start.

Warmly,
Elena
Garden Coordinator, Hollis Street Community Garden
